articles.summary: The 2022 State of the American Driver report offers insights into how the ongoing pandemic is reshaping car ownership for Americans, how they are reacting to chip shortages and rising gas prices, their outlook for buying and selling vehicles in the year ahead, their views on electric and autonomous vehicles, and their attitudes toward commuting, ride-hailing and the cost of driving.
articles.title: Jerry 2022 State of the American Driver Report

articles.summary: The 2023 State of the American Driver report offers insights into how a second pandemic-era year of supply shortages and the strongest inflation in four decades is affecting American car owners, the financial burden many take on to stay on the road, their growing interest in electric vehicles after a year of record-high gas prices, their commuting habits, and their views on rising road rage and driver safety.
articles.title: Jerry 2023 State of the American Driver Report

articles.summary: The 2024 State of the American Driver report offers insights into how a third year of elevated car-ownership costs is affecting Americans, the steepest jump in car insurance premiums since the 1980s, their cautiously renewed appetite for buying as interest rate cuts loom, their decisive shift toward hybrids over electric vehicles, and the road safety crisis playing out on America's streets.
articles.title: Jerry 2024 State of the American Driver Report
